name: coordkit-protocol
purpose: Explicit protocol contract for CoordKit coordination objects, messages, and invariants.
invariants: event identity is stable and deduplicated by eid
schema migration is explicit and non-destructive
malformed or partial input must not wedge the runtime
transport changes replication, not protocol meaning
next_split: split shared protocol types out of plugin packaging
move runtime-owned protocol behavior into packages/
keep plugin-side scripts as wrappers only
